title: Steering Causal Effect through Data Preparation Pipeline Search
summary: A research framework for automatically constructing data preparation pipelines that steer estimated causal effect (ATE) into a target range via search algorithms (brute force, pruned, probabilistic, and LLM-guided). The repository bundles a large collection of unrelated third-party Kaggle notebooks, some of which mention CTGAN, TVAE, or SDGym incidentally, with no connection to the SDV family in the project's own code.
evidence: SDV/CTGAN/TVAE/SDGym mentions appear only inside unrelated vendored Kaggle notebooks under notebooks_new/, not in the project's own pipeline-search code.
needs: Unclear why unrelated third-party Kaggle notebooks are bundled in this repo; no actual SDV usage found in the causal-effect-search codebase itself.
